title: Run map
description: One run's map (R1, R2) in data/map/<id>.json: nodes joined by routes. The player starts on a node of the lowest row and follows one route per step until a node with no route out. A node's row is data (where it sits), not an index: the game walks routes only. The schema stays open on purpose: 'type' and 'yokai' are free ids (the game's node-type registry decides which types exist) and 'payload' is opaque to the map, so rewards, merchant, dojo and per-node scenes add fields later without a schema break.

schema_version.description: Bumped when the meaning of a field changes; the loader rejects versions it does not know.

rules.description: Rule IDs this map follows. Listing R1 makes the validator hold the map to R1's row layout; a map that leaves it out is only checked as a graph.

row.description: Which row the node sits in, counted from the start (R1: 1-8, the boss after them).

type.description: Node type id, resolved by the game's node-type registry (duel, elder, boss, merchant, dojo today).

yokai.description: Who waits there (R2): a fighter id such as kitsune, elder-oni, apprentice, tanuki. Required by fight node types.

elder.description: Shows the elder twist icon on the node (Y3). Default false.

label.description: Text shown on the node; without it the screen names the yokai or the type.

payload.description: Free-form fields for the node type's own systems (rewards, shop stock, scene, trial...). The map never reads it.

routes.description: Lines between nodes. Each goes from a node to a node in the next row.
